decisive_items: Round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube
Fleshy mass bulging from the right cornual area
Loose fibromyxoid stroma without mitotic atypia
response.rationale: R7 uniquely combines the tubal location (isthmus, cornual) with the characteristic pathology of epithelioid cords around vessels and loose fibromyxoid stroma, matching adenomatoid tumor. R4 only cites location without the distinctive histology, while other candidates are contradicted by the benign pathology, tubal site, or lack of supporting raw spans.

rejected.why: Contradicted by 'benign lesion' and 'without mitotic atypia' on final pathology.
Lacks tubal location and is undermined by 'well-demarcated border' and benign pathology.
Location is uterine, not tubal; pathology and imaging are more consistent with adenomatoid tumor.
Pathology shows spindle/epithelioid cells and vascular pattern, not adenomyosis; also lacks tubal location.
